entries.comment: Empire State Building at its place on the New York City map. pak128 has no such object; the map marks the place (label Empire State Bldg, 5th Avenue between 33rd and 34th Street) with two attractions ABBYS_0 at 409,452 and 409,453, which the model covers.

Statue of Liberty on Liberty Island of the New York City map. pak128 has no such object; the island (label Liberty Island at 378,657) holds two attractions WOODEN_CHURCH at 378,657 and 378,658, which the model covers; the other WOODEN_CHURCH of the map (427,589) stays a generated church.
